description.main: The American volume of Hedi Slimane's four-part Anthology of a Decade (JRP|Ringier, 2011), collecting black-and-white photographs made in New York and Los Angeles between 2007 and 2011. Portraits of Gore Vidal, Kenneth Anger, Ed Ruscha, Courtney Love and Johnny Rotten sit alongside skaters, surfers, street scenes and still lifes across 212 pages.
description.extended:
The American volume of Hedi Slimane's four-part Anthology of a Decade, collecting the black-and-white photographs he made in New York and Los Angeles between 2007 and 2011.

JRP|Ringier published Anthology of a Decade in 2011 as four softcover volumes in a slipcase, one for each territory Slimane worked in during the 2000s. Lionel Bovier edited the set, printed in an edition of 1,000 and sold as single volumes from 2012. The US book runs to 212 pages and 201 duotone plates. The sitters include Gore Vidal, Kenneth Anger, Ed Ruscha, Courtney Love, Joe Dallesandro, Johnny Rotten, Brice Marden and Brian Wilson. Around them are young models, skaters and surfers, street scenes, landscapes and still lifes. Among the objects photographed are Vidal's typewriter, one of Beck's acoustic guitars, a Python .357 revolver and the tattoos of the artist Banks Violette. The cover carries the Stars and Stripes in black and grey, the flag device shared across the set.

Slimane (b. 1968, Paris) ran Dior Homme from 2000 to 2007 and spent the years that followed in Los Angeles, photographing full time. These are the pictures he carried back into fashion when he took over Yves Saint Laurent in 2012 and moved its design studio to Los Angeles.
description.artist_bio: Hedi Slimane (b. 1968, Paris) was menswear director at Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche (1997-2000), creative director of Dior Homme (2000-2007), Yves Saint Laurent (2012-2016) and Celine (2018-2024), and has run a photography practice throughout, with books including Berlin (Steidl/7L, 2003), Stage (Steidl/7L, 2004), London Birth of a Cult (Steidl, 2005) and Interzone (Purple Books, 2005).

notes: Shelf: Fashion. Volume US of the four-volume Anthology of a Decade (JRP|Ringier, 2011), the others being UK (9783037642221), FR (9783037642238) and DE RU (9783037642245). Also issued as a slipcased set of all four, ISBN 9783037641156 (724 pages). Volumes sold separately from 2012. Listed by JRP|Ringier and D.A.P. as USA; cover reads US.

research_log.notes: Publisher page and D.A.P. agree on ISBN, pages, 232 x 290 mm, softcover, edition of 1,000, editor Lionel Bovier. Image count from the publisher (201 b/w); D.A.P. gives a slightly different count for the US and UK volumes. Year: the set was issued April 2011 (JRP, Getty); JRP and D.A.P. date the single-volume release February/April 2012. Subtitle taken from the cover as printed (US), not from the trade listing name (USA). OpenLibrary attaches Vince Aletti and Jon Savage as authors across these ISBNs, which no publisher or Getty record supports, so no essayists are recorded.
